enabledPlatforms.title: Trigger platforms
enabledPlatforms.description: One per line: twitch, youtube, kick, or tiktok.

triggerOnFirstChat.title: Welcome a viewer on their first safe message of the day
triggerOnFirstChat.description: Runs at most once per stable platform account per calendar day after the welcome safety gate approves the message.

firstChatResetHours.title: Legacy inactivity reset
firstChatResetHours.description: Accepted only so older saved settings remain compatible. Daily welcomes now reset by the configured timezone.

firstChatAudience.title: Who can receive an automatic welcome?
firstChatAudience.description: Safe all uses the safety gate. Allowlist only also requires a matching entry below.

firstChatAllowlist.title: Optional first-chat allowlist
firstChatAllowlist.description: Used only in Allowlist only mode. One per line: username, platform:username, or platform:id:stable-user-id.

welcomeTimeZone.title: Daily reset timezone
welcomeTimeZone.description: IANA timezone such as America/Chicago. Invalid values safely fall back to UTC.

welcomeSafetyMode.title: Welcome safety level
welcomeSafetyMode.description: Balanced is recommended. Strict applies tighter message-shape limits. Open still blocks ignored accounts and explicit blocked terms/domains.

welcomeDelaySeconds.title: Safety delay before welcoming (seconds)
welcomeDelaySeconds.description: Provides a short review window and prevents instant overlay bursts.

welcomeRequireStableId.title: Require a stable platform user ID
welcomeRequireStableId.description: Recommended. Prevents display-name changes from bypassing the once-per-day gate.

welcomeRejectLinks.title: Reject first messages containing links
welcomeRejectLinks.description: Recommended for Balanced and Strict modes. Manual shoutouts are unaffected.

welcomeBlockedTerms.title: Spam phrases that block an automatic welcome
welcomeBlockedTerms.description: Preinstalled high-confidence promotion phrases. Edit, add, or remove one literal phrase per line.

welcomeBlockedDomains.title: Spam websites that block an automatic welcome
welcomeBlockedDomains.description: Preinstalled promotion domains. Enter hostnames only; edit, add, or remove them at any time.

manualCommandName.title: Manual command name
manualCommandName.description: Registered automatically through the main chat intakes after restart. The built-in alias is !so and only moderators or the broadcaster are authorized.

ignoreConnectedAccounts.title: Block my connected creator and bot accounts
ignoreConnectedAccounts.description: Recommended. Automatic welcomes and raid shoutouts ignore broadcaster and bot identities detected from Streamer.bot, including learned aliases shared with TikFinity. Moderator-issued commands remain available.

ignoredUsers.title: Never shout out or welcome these users
ignoredUsers.description: Preloaded with common service bots and the THSV bot accounts. Same matching format as the allowlist; edit, add, or remove entries at any time. This list wins over every automatic or manual trigger.

selectedPlatforms.title: Selected destination platforms
selectedPlatforms.description: Used only when delivery mode is selected. One platform per line.

raidTemplate.title: Twitch raid message
raidTemplate.description: Sent only after Twitch returns a non-empty category. Tokens: {displayName}, {user}, {category}, {channelUrl}, {viewers}, {trigger}.
raidTemplate.default: Thank you {displayName} for the raid with {viewers} viewers! They stream {category}. Watch them at {channelUrl}

twitchFirstChatTemplate.title: Twitch creator first-chat message
twitchFirstChatTemplate.description: Only allowlisted users with a confirmed Twitch category qualify.

twitchViewerWelcomeTemplate.title: Twitch viewer first-chat welcome
twitchViewerWelcomeTemplate.description: Used once per stream for an allowlisted Twitch first-time chatter when the verified lookup returns no current category. This is a welcome, not a streamer promotion.
twitchViewerWelcomeTemplate.default: Welcome to the stream, {displayName}! Thanks for joining us on Twitch.

twitchViewerWelcomeAlternates.title: Additional Twitch welcome messages
twitchViewerWelcomeAlternates.description: One message per line. A stable random choice is made for each approved daily arrival.
default: Glad you made it, {displayName}! Welcome to the Twitch side of the village.
Hey {displayName}! Settle in and enjoy the stream with us.
A new Villager has arrived! Welcome in, {displayName}.

youtubeWelcomeTemplate.title: YouTube first-chat welcome
youtubeWelcomeTemplate.description: A welcome only; Streamer.bot cannot verify an arbitrary YouTube chatter's current category.
youtubeWelcomeTemplate.default: Welcome to the stream, {displayName}! Thanks for joining us on YouTube.

youtubeWelcomeAlternates.title: Additional YouTube welcome messages
default: Glad you found the village, {displayName}! Welcome to the YouTube stream.
Hey {displayName}! Thanks for spending some time with us on YouTube.
Welcome in, {displayName}! The village is happy to have you here.

kickWelcomeTemplate.title: Kick first-chat welcome
kickWelcomeTemplate.description: A welcome only; Streamer.bot exposes the connected Kick broadcaster, not an arbitrary chatter's category.
kickWelcomeTemplate.default: Welcome to the stream, {displayName}! Thanks for joining us on Kick.

kickWelcomeAlternates.title: Additional Kick welcome messages
default: Glad you made it, {displayName}! Welcome to the Kick side of the village.
Hey {displayName}! Pull up a seat and enjoy the Kick stream.
A new Villager has arrived on Kick! Welcome, {displayName}.

tiktokWelcomeTemplate.title: TikTok first-chat welcome
tiktokWelcomeTemplate.description: A welcome only; TikFinity does not provide a current channel category for the chatter.
tiktokWelcomeTemplate.default: Welcome, {displayName}! Thanks for joining the TikTok live.

tiktokWelcomeAlternates.title: Additional TikTok welcome messages
default: Hey {displayName}! Welcome to the village on TikTok LIVE.
Glad you found us, {displayName}! Enjoy the TikTok LIVE.
Welcome in, {displayName}! Thanks for joining the village.

manualTwitchTemplate.title: Manual Twitch shoutout message
manualTwitchTemplate.description: The target is still category-verified before this message is sent.

manualChannelTemplate.title: Manual YouTube, Kick, and TikTok shoutout
manualChannelTemplate.description: Moderator-selected channel link; no category claim is made.
manualChannelTemplate.default: Go check out {displayName} at {channelUrl} and show them some love!

onePerStream.title: Shout out each user only once per stream

twitchShoutoutMode.title: Twitch shoutout mode
twitchShoutoutMode.description: Native uses Streamer.bot's Twitch API action and its platform cooldowns. Both sends native plus editable text.

showOverlayCard.title: Show a platform-colored visual card
showOverlayCard.description: Uses Twitch purple, YouTube red, Kick green, or TikTok cyan/pink without playing clips.

overlayPlatforms.title: Platforms allowed to show welcome cards

twitchVisualTriggers.title: Show the visual card for
twitchVisualTriggers.description: Choose which automated or manual paths may display a card.

twitchVisualType.title: Legacy popup style (ignored)
twitchVisualType.description: Retained only so older saved settings migrate safely. Automated Shoutouts now always uses a profile or welcome card.

overlayCardTemplate.title: Profile-card message
overlayCardTemplate.default: Go show {displayName} some love! They stream {category}. {channelUrl}
